result.title: NativeDrive: Native Multimodal Foundations for Autonomous Driving
result.comment: 16 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables, including supplementary material
result.summary: Autonomous driving requires semantic understanding and fine-grained scene perception for precise action prediction. Vision-language-action models (VLAs) inherit semantic priors, but low-dimensional action labels provide limited structural supervision. Some studies extend VLAs with visual generation tasks or adopt video-based world-action models (WAMs), but both approaches introduce appearance-reconstruction overhead, which is less relevant to planning. Native multimodal models offer an alternative to unify understanding and generation within one backbone. On this basis, we propose NativeDrive, a native encoder-free multimodal driving framework adapting the unified backbone for policy learning and introduce a dense supervision task tailored to driving. The Native Action Interface reuses the understanding expert's token-prediction interface for the discrete policy and adapts the generation expert for continuous policy. Driving Semantic Editing reuses the generation expert's editing capability for dense scene-structure supervision during training, while inference runs only the selected planning policy. NativeDrive achieves competitive planning performance among unified understanding-and-generation models on NAVSIM v1 and v2, with ablations validating its components' effectiveness. Code will be released.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 NativeDrive，一个无编码器的原生多模态驾驶框架：在统一理解与生成的骨干上，复用理解专家的 token 预测接口输出离散策略、改造生成专家输出连续策略，并在训练期借生成专家的编辑能力提供密集场景结构监督，推理时只运行所选规划策略。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「训练期用生成分支做密集监督、推理期只跑策略」的解耦方式，可供核查 LVR 中辅助监督与推理成本、贡献分配的关系；但对象是驾驶动作而非 latent 视觉推理状态，线索较间接。
